prompt: I'm a concert venue in Washington, D.C. Blink-182 played here on their tour the same year Brazil won their fifth FIFA World Cup. What was my name in 2010?
answer: You were the **MCI Center** in Washington, D.C. Blink-182 played there in 2002, the year Brazil won its fifth FIFA World Cup. In **2010**, your name was **Verizon Center** (now Capital One Arena).
